links.comparator_used: Default (conventional) classification threshold for the same model
links.outcome: Sensitivity and missed parasitized cells (false negatives) on held-out test set
links.effect: Deeper CNN after validation-selected F2-optimized threshold: sensitivity 97.05% (95% CI 96.23%-97.70%), F2-score 96.01%, false-negative rate 2.95%; missed parasitized cells fell from 177 to 61 relative to its default threshold.
links.quote: It reduced missed parasitized cells from 177 to 61 relative to its default threshold.

links.comparator_used: Individual custom CNNs (compact CNN and deeper CNN)
links.outcome: Accuracy at conventional threshold and screening-oriented sensitivity/F2 after threshold optimization
links.effect: The equal-weight ensemble did not top either ranking: the compact CNN had the highest accuracy at the conventional threshold (95.26%), and the deeper CNN had the strongest screening-oriented result (97.05% sensitivity). No ensemble figures reported in the abstract.
links.quote: At the conventional threshold, the compact CNN achieved the highest accuracy (95.26%).

design_hint: alert/operating threshold selection (sensitivity-oriented F2 threshold optimization)
